buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The Bidder must fulfil the Minimum Qualifying Requirements and other requirements stipulated in the Bid.

1.1 MINIMUM QUALIFYING REQUIREMENTS: In order to be qualified for award of Contract, the bidder i.e. Firms/ Companies/Proprietary firms /, as the case may be, (hereinafter referred as Party/ Parties/contractor will be required to satisfy the following minimum qualifying criteria, which take precedence over any qualification requirement s that may be stated in the specifications or elsewhere in the Bidding Document. FINANCE CRITERIA: Average annual financial turnover of the tenderer during last three financial years ending 31.03.202 5 shall be at least Rs. 68.18 Lakhs (Without GST). The Tenderer shall submit copies of `Balance sheets’ and `Audited Profit and Loss Account statement bearing UDIN for last three financial year s (i.e. 2023-2024, 2024-25 and 2025-2026) duly certified by the Chartered Accountant (C.A.) cl early indicating registration number/UDIN along with details as per Schedule-E of tender document. 1.2 Mandatory Experience in EHV Power Transformers The bidder shall be either OEM or an OEM authorised service provider or a contractor and should h ave successfully carried out repair/overhauling/rewinding/refurbishment of at least three Power/Dis tribution/Generator Transformers of 132 kV or higher voltage class with at least 15 MVA rating irre spective of order value, during the last seven years ending on the last day of the month preceding the month in which the tender is invited. The above EHV Power Transformer experience is mandatory and shall be considered irrespective o f the monetary value of the work executed. Accordingly, no minimum contract value is envisaged f or the specific EHV Power Transformer repair/overhauling experience. The bidder shall submit documentary evidence, such as a work order along with a completion certi ficate/performance certificate issued by the concerned client or MOM after completion of works or Taking over certificate by the client or any other document which can substantiate claim of having executed said work from the client shall be submitted with bid clearly indicating the voltage class, MVA rating and nature of repair/overhauling work executed. 1.3 Financial Value of Similar Works In addition to fulfilling the above mandatory EHV Power Transformer experience requirement, the Bidder shall also have successfully completed similar work/s during the last 07 (seven) years endin g on the last day of month before the one in which the tender is invited, meeting any one of the foll owing a. Three similar completed works each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs. 90.90 L akh (Excluding GST) during last 7 years from the date on which subject tender is floated. OR b. Two similar completed works each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs. 113.63 La kh (Excluding GST) during last 7 years from the date on which subject tender is floated. OR c. One similar completed work costing not less than the amount equal to Rs 181.81 Lakh (Exc luding GST) during last 7 years from the date on which subject tender is floated. d. Definition of similar works: Similar works shall mean repair/ overhauling / rewinding / refurbishm ent / replacement of windings, restoration and associated testing and commissioning of oil-filled t hree-phase power & distribution transformer/s of 22 kV and above voltage class. e. The mandatory EHV Power Transformer experience stipulated under Clause 1.2 and the financial value criteria stipulated under Clause 1.3 shall be evaluated independently. The bidder may rely on separate completed work orders to establish compliance with the above two requirements. Ho wever, fulfilment of both requirements shall be mandatory for technical qualification. The same w ork order may also be considered towards fulfilment of both requirements, provided it independe ntly satisfies the respective conditions. f. In support, the tenderer shall submit self-attested copy/copies of order/s in full along with releva nt annexures/documents forming the part of the order with relevant completion or performance c ertificates as issued by clients indicating Final/completed contract value of the work executed or MOM recorded after completion of works or Taking over certificate by the client or any other doc ument which can substantiate claim of having executed said work from the client. If order is exec uted for private Party copies of TDS certificate for the same order shall be submitted. The Bidder shall submit the documentary evidence to show that they have executed the above works succes sfully & satisfactorily. Completion certificates indicating Partially completed works/Work in progre

ss will not be considered. The Bidder should furnish the information of the Bid document. Experience certificates of works executed in private sectors/ organizations shall be considered for qualification, only on submission of Form 26AS from TRACES Site along with work order and compl etion certificate. 1.4 The bidder shall possess a valid Electrical contractor license issued by the Electrical inspectorate/Co mpetent authority of any state government, preferably valid on the date of submission. The contra ctor shall deploy a qualified electrical supervisor having a valid certificate of competency and licen sed electrical workmen for execution of the works in accordance with the provisions of the Central Electricity Authority (Measures relating to Safety and Electric supply) Regulations, 2023 and the ap plicable State Electricity Rules/Regulations. The copy of the same shall be submitted in Technical Bid. In case the validity of license is expired r ecently (within 01-month period before publish of subject Bid) and it is under process of renewal, a proof to that effect shall be submitted with technical bid, however renewed License copy shall be s ubmitted with 15 days from the date of opening of technical bid otherwise the bid will be treated a s disqualified and it will not be considered for further evaluation. 1.5 The bidder shall have Experienced transformer engineers and supervisors on his roll and shall als o have Adequate workshop for transformer repairing works with testing and repair facilities. 1.6 The bidder shall furnish details of PAN and GST Registration of his firm along with copy of docume nts as evidence. The Bidder is required to submit documentary evidence in support of all the pre-qualifying criteria mentioned above as a part of its techno-commercial bid. The firm, which fulfils the entire qualifying requirements mentioned above, will only be considered qualified for Technical and Price evaluation . 1. Successful bidder shall submit Performance Security Guarantee of 10% 2. The bidders shall upload Price Schedule -I & Price Schedule -II in pdf file as per available prov ision on GeM in Financial breakup ( as per formats in tender document) 3. EMD and Security Deposit (Performance Security) shall be accepted only the following modes: NEFT / RTGS E-Bank Guarantee Insurance Surety Bond 4. Submission of EMD and Security Deposit (Performance Security) through Cheque or Demand Draft s hall n ot be accepted under any circumstances. 5. No hard copy of E-BG is required at JNPA office. 4. No Bank Guarantee in the physical form will be accepted. 5. E-BG will be issued directly by the bank via NeSL. 6. E-BG is a fully valid form of document. The Bidders are requested to reach the Bank with following details and issue the E-BG in favour of JNPA: Entity Name: Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority PAN/UIN: AAALJ0036D
